title: StudyProtocol
description: The protocol part of a study manifest (10D-2, D-1366; review 14 M14-1): what the coordinating centre fixes for every site, read from rulesets/<ID>/ by tb_common.study_manifest. Its canonical serialisation (keys sorted, no spaces, UTF-8) hashes to criteria_sha256, the same on every site that adopts it; a site edit to any of it is refused. Schema version 1.0.0.

criteria_sha256.description: sha256 of the canonical serialisation of schema, manifest and files (every key but this one)

manifest.description: the protocol fields of rulesets/<ID>/manifest.yaml, each value as ruleset_manifest.schema.json defines it

files.description: the protocol's files of rulesets/<ID>/ by relative path (criteria IR, value sets, CQL and ELM, SQL, labels, synthetic test patients and their expected results), each the sha256 of its canonical bytes; a criterion IR file without the site's review record (who, when, comment, approved or draft)

additionalProperties.description: lowercase hex sha256; the key is a path relative to rulesets/<ID>/, never absolute and never with ..
